description: Three stacked pseudo-binary phase diagrams of the same construction: temperature T (°C), 200-1600 (y-axis), versus carbon content C (wt%), 0-4 (x-axis), with "Fe" printed at the 0 wt% C origin. (a) Fe-C: phase fields L+δ, L, L+γ, γ, γ+M3C, α and α+M3C; the eutectoid point S is marked at about 0.8 wt% C just above the 700 °C gridline, and point E where the γ field closes is near 2 wt% C at ~1150 °C. (b) Fe-15Mn-C: the δ-related fields shrink to a narrow top-left corner, the γ field extends to lower temperatures, S moves to lower C (~0.3-0.4 wt%, near 600 °C), and new low-temperature fields appear — α+γ, α+γ+M3C, α+γ+M23C6, α+M23C6+M7C3, α+M7C3, α+M3C, α+M3C+M7C3 — reflecting M7C3 and M23C6 carbides. (c) Fe-7Al-C: the δ+γ region is enlarged, γ+κ, γ+κ+M3C, α(δ)+γ+κ, α+κ, α+κ+M3C and B2+κ fields appear, and a dashed curve descends from ~500 °C at low C to ~250 °C at ~2.3 wt% C marking the A2→B2 ordering transition; SE is the κ-carbide solvus. Together the panels show how Mn and Al additions redistribute the Fe-C phase fields. No numeric data labels are printed.

observations.observation: The figure is a three-panel stack sharing identical axes: T (°C) from 200 to 1600 on the y-axis and C (wt%) from 0 to 4 on the x-axis, with 'Fe' printed at the 0 wt.% C position.
In (a) the eutectoid point S is labelled at approximately 0.8 wt.% C, just above the 700 °C gridline, and point E at the tip of the γ field lies near 2 wt.% C, ~1150 °C.
Panel (a) labels the fields L+δ, L, L+γ, γ, γ+M3C, α and α+M3C.
In (b) the δ-related fields are reduced to a small top-left corner and the γ field extends to lower temperature, with S shifted to low C (below ~0.5 wt.%) near 600 °C.
Panel (b) contains additional low-temperature fields α+γ, α+γ+M3C, α+γ+M23C6, α+M23C6+M7C3, α+M7C3, α+M3C and α+M3C+M7C3, i.e. M7C3 and M23C6 carbide fields absent from (a).
Panel (c) contains the fields γ+κ, γ+κ+M3C, α(δ)+γ+κ, α+κ, α+κ+M3C and B2+κ, replacing the (γ+M3C) region of the Fe-C diagram.
A dashed line in (c) descends from about 500 °C at 0 wt.% C to about 250 °C at ~2.3 wt.% C.
The caption states that the dashed line in Fig. 5c indicates the A2 to B2 transition temperature caused by Al addition.
The caption identifies the panels as (a) Fe-C, (b) Fe-15Mn-C and (c) Fe-7Al-C, describing the effects of Mn and Al addition on the phase constituent and phase fields of the Fe-C system.

The citing text states that when Mn is added the high-temperature peritectic reaction shifts to a lower C range and disappears completely above ~13% Mn, and that the γ single-phase field is extended to lower temperatures.
The citing text states that the temperature of the S point drops to about 386 °C with 30% Mn added, while the C concentration of the E point is less affected by Mn content.
The citing text states that Mn addition to the Fe-C system forms M7C3 and M23C6 carbides in addition to cementite (M3C), and that a new phase called b-Mn may appear above 20% Mn.

The citing text states that with Al addition the (γ + M3C) area of the Fe-C system is replaced by (γ + κ) and (γ + κ + M3C) areas, and the single γ area is shifted to the right because the C concentrations of the S and E points increase.

The citing text identifies the SE line in Fig. 5c as the solvus temperature of κ-carbide formation, and states that the A2 (disordered) to B2 (ordered) transition occurs below 500 °C, decreasing with increasing C, and has not yet been confirmed experimentally.
No numeric values are printed on any panel; the coordinates of S and E must be read from the gridlines.

subfigures.description: Fe-C phase diagram, T (°C) 200-1600 vs C (wt%) 0-4. Fields: L+δ (top-left corner), L, L+γ, γ, γ+M3C (right), α (thin sliver at left edge below ~700 °C) and α+M3C (bottom). Point S (eutectoid) labelled at ~0.8 wt% C just above the 700 °C line; point E labelled at the tip of the γ field near 2 wt% C, ~1150 °C.

Fe-15Mn-C phase diagram, same axes. Top: narrow L+δ corner, L, L+γ, wide γ field reaching down to ~600 °C. S labelled at low C (~0.3-0.4 wt%). Lower half filled with the fields α+γ, α+γ+M3C, α+γ+M23C6, α+M23C6+M7C3, α+M7C3, α+M3C and α+M3C+M7C3; E labelled near 2.2 wt% C at ~1100 °C. Lower-left field labels are small and crowded.

Fe-7Al-C phase diagram, same axes. Enlarged δ and δ+γ fields at top-left, L, L+γ, γ, γ+κ, γ+κ+M3C, α(δ)+γ+κ, α+κ, α+κ+M3C and B2+κ. S labelled at ~0.9 wt% C, ~1000 °C; E near 2.5 wt% C, ~1150 °C. A dashed line runs from about 500 °C at 0 wt% C down to ~250 °C at ~2.3 wt% C.
